inventory.name: Mastercrafted Sword
inventory.effect: Once per Activation or Reaction, the user may reroll 1 Attack roll.

inventory.name: Parrying Dagger
inventory.effect: The target's Melee Attacks suffer a -2 mod. When used against a model in Crouched State, gain +1 STK.

stratagems.name: Dishearten
stratagems.effect: Target 1 enemy in LoS, it must perform a halved M roll. On fail, it loses 1 Activation Point every turn, until your next Strategic Phase.

stratagems.name: Guerrilla Tactics
stratagems.effect: Assassins and Rogues gain the Hit and Retreat and Backstab skills.

stratagems.name: Vicious Opportunism
stratagems.effect: Attacks by friendly models against Crouched models may reroll 1 Attack roll, gain +6 PW and Cleave.
